question: Which of the following cities hosted the G20 Digital Economy Working Groups' second meeting in South Africa in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eastern Cape**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Africa** officially assumed the **G20 Presidency** on **December 1, 2024**, succeeding **Brazil**. As part of its **2025** calendar, the nation hosted various working group meetings across its provinces.
 
• The **second meeting** of the **G20 Digital Economy Working Group (DEWG)** was scheduled to be hosted in the **Eastern Cape** province in **2025**. 
 
• The **Digital Economy Working Group (DEWG)** meetings are a critical part of the **Sherpa Track**, focusing on the transformative power of digital technologies to drive inclusive economic growth.
 
• The **Department of Communications and Digital Technologies (DCDT)** of **South Africa** led the organization of these meetings, ensuring that the agenda aligned with the national and continental goals of digital transformation.
 
• The discussions in the **Eastern Cape** centered on the development of **Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)**, enhancing **Cybersecurity**, and fostering **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** for sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **G20 South Africa 2025 Theme:**
 
 
• The theme for the **South African G20 Presidency** is **"Solidarity, Equality and Sustainability"**.
 
• This theme reflects **South Africa’s** commitment to addressing the needs of the **Global South** and ensuring that the digital economy benefits everyone, reducing the **Digital Divide**.
 
 
 
• **Digital Economy Working Group (DEWG) History:**
 
 
• The **DEWG** was originally established as the **Digital Economy Task Force** in **2017** during the **German G20 Presidency**.
 
• It was later elevated to a formal **Working Group** to address the increasing importance of digital policies in global economic stability and innovation.
 
 
 
• **The Troika:**
 
 
• During **2025**, the **G20 Troika** consists of **Brazil** (previous host), **South Africa** (current host), and the **United States of America** (incoming host for **2026**).
 
• This ensures continuity in the **G20** agenda across different presidencies.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Eastern Cape:**
 
 
• Hosting the meeting in the **Eastern Cape** highlights **South Africa's** strategy to distribute **G20** events across various regions to promote local tourism and showcase provincial development.
 
• The province is a significant industrial hub, particularly for the **automotive sector**, which is increasingly reliant on digital integration and **Industry 4.0**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **G20 Composition:** The **G20** comprises **19 countries**, the **European Union**, and recently, the **African Union**, which was admitted as a permanent member during the **New Delhi Summit** in **2023**.
 
• **Priority Areas:** South Africa’s priorities for the digital track include **Digital Inclusion**, **Human-Centric AI**, and **Data for Development**.
 
• **Global Impact:** The outcomes of the **DEWG** meetings contribute to the **G20 Leaders' Declaration**, which sets global standards for digital governance and cooperation.
